operations.title: Entry 1410 — The Mellin Xi Jet Boundary Has the Completed Determinant
operations.summary: The source-saturated Mellin quotient B/(Xi), its intrinsic jet associated graded, and residue degree-reversal polarization produce a closed normal compact-resolvent operator with full Xi divisor and theta-normalized determinant Xi. Euler-domain Mellin modes are total. Self-adjointness is equivalent to RH.

operations.title: A source-saturated Mellin jet boundary has discrete spectrum and completed-Xi determinant
operations.statement: The CCM Mellin source range generates the ideal (Xi). The maximal-ideal associated graded of B/(Xi), completed in the residue-polarized jet norm, carries the closed normal operator A e_(lambda,k)=lambda e_(lambda,k), with compact resolvent, full zero multiplicities, and Xi(z)=Xi(0) det_2(I-zA^-1). Euler-domain Cauchy Mellin modes are total. A is self-adjoint iff RH.
operations.scope: Completes the analytic boundary/quotient objective without a zero list; does not prove RH or the separate physical coefficient–Betti chain pushforward.

operations.title: Mellin Xi boundary end-to-end theorem audit
